allow_plain.description: Allow PLAIN authentication (not recommended unless needed)

chatroom.description: MUC JID to send messages to (e.g., room@chat.example.org)

fast_off.description: Disable XEP-0484: Fast Authentication Streamlining Tokens

jserver.description: XMPP server address (optional; overrides server discovery)

ox.description: Enable OpenPGP for XMPP encryption (experimental, 1:1 only)

ox_genprivkey_rsa.description: Generate RSA 4096-bit OpenPGP private key for account

ox_genprivkey_x25519.description: Generate X25519 OpenPGP private key for account

ox_import_privkey.description: Path to existing private OpenPGP key to import

ox_passphrase.description: Passphrase to protect the OpenPGP private key

ssdp_off.description: Disable XEP-0474: SASL SCRAM Downgrade Protection

suppress_root_warning.description: Suppress warning when running as root

tls_verify.description: Verify TLS certificates (default: true; set to false to skip verification)
